ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle ABD, and point C is located on line segment BD. Line segment BC is labeled 15, and line segment CD is also labeled 15. The line passing through A and C intersects BD at C, and there is a right-angle mark at C, indicating that AC is perpendicular to BD. Side AB is labeled 5x - 11, and side AD is labeled 3x + 5. Reasoning: Because BC = 15 and CD = 15, C is the midpoint of BD. Also because AC ⟂ BD, AC is the perpendicular bisector of BD. Point A is on the perpendicular bisector of BD, therefore the distances from A to B and D are equal, that is, AB = AD. From the labels in the figure, we get 5x - 11 = 3x + 5. Solving gives 2x = 16, so x = 8. Thus AB = 5(8) - 11 = 40 - 11 = 29.
